# Shapes

Validation artifacts generated from the LinkML source at `schema/pkm.yaml`.

**These files are generated — do not edit them by hand.** Run `make shapes` to
regenerate. The OWL ontology, by contrast, is hand-authored; LinkML is used only for
the data-shape layer.

## Download

- `pkm.shacl.ttl` — SHACL shapes _(run `make shapes`)_
- `pkm.schema.json` — JSON Schema _(run `make shapes`)_
